name: @seaveyon/dsh-pet-desktop
description: Zero-native (Zig + GPU canvas) desktop pet for the DSH Web surface; receives mood state from the dsh-pet plugin over a loopback HTTP bridge
author: B1anker

scripts.build: command -v zig >/dev/null 2>&1 && zig build || echo 'skip: zig not installed (see README)'
scripts.test:unit: bun run test:zig && bun run test:js
scripts.test:zig: command -v zig >/dev/null 2>&1 && zig build test || echo 'skip: zig not installed (see README)'
